01_geometry.description: Exact circles sampled for vector paths; filled lens shown once.

02_normalized.evaluation: mpmath 80 digits, converted to binary64 for drawing

03_shape_invariant.evaluation: 80 digits; endpoint curve evaluated by high-precision subtraction

plot_limit_metadata.meaning: J(0+)=0 is a one-sided limit only. A/P^2 is undefined at (P,A)=(0,0).

05_absolute_sensitivity.error_model: Local absolute errors in A and P, in a fixed chosen length unit; coefficient magnitudes have different dimensions. Not finite perturbations.
05_absolute_sensitivity.excluded_endpoint: theta=0; divergent coefficients are not plotted there.

06_relative_sensitivity.excluded_endpoints: u=0 and u=1; endpoint limits are analytic, not finite plotted values.
